title: चतुरधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 204 · Sunda and Upasunda kill each other

summary.en: The brothers, carousing on the Vindhya, see Tilottama and each seizes her hand, claiming her as his wife; they fight with clubs and kill each other. Narada urges the Pandavas to avoid such a fate, and they agree that whoever intrudes on another brother alone with Draupadi shall go to the forest for twelve years.
summary.kn: ವಿಂಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಹರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಸಹೋದರರು ತಿಲೋತ್ತಮೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಅವಳ ಕೈ ಹಿಡಿದು ತನ್ನ ಪತ್ನಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಗದೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಂಥ ಗತಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಎಂದು ನಾರದರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ; ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಏಕಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಹೋದರನನ್ನು ಭಂಗಪಡಿಸಿದವನು ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ವರ್ಷ ವನವಾಸ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಪಾಂಡವರು ನಿಯಮ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: विन्ध्य पर रंगरलियाँ मनाते भाई तिलोत्तमा को देखते हैं और दोनों उसका हाथ पकड़कर उसे अपनी पत्नी बताते हैं; वे गदाओं से लड़कर एक-दूसरे को मार डालते हैं। नारद पाण्डवों से ऐसी गति से बचने को कहते हैं, और वे नियम बनाते हैं कि जो भाई द्रौपदी के साथ एकान्त में बैठे दूसरे भाई के पास जाएगा, वह बारह वर्ष वन में रहेगा।
summary.te: వింధ్యపై విహరిస్తున్న సోదరులు తిలోత్తమను చూసి ఇద్దరూ ఆమె చేయి పట్టి తన భార్య అంటారు; గదలతో పోరాడి ఒకరినొకరు చంపుకుంటారు. అలాంటి గతి తప్పించుకోమని నారదుడు చెబుతాడు; ద్రౌపదితో ఏకాంతంలో ఉన్న సోదరుని భంగపరిచినవాడు పన్నెండేళ్లు వనవాసం చేయాలని పాండవులు నియమం చేసుకుంటారు.
summary.ta: விந்திய மலையில் களித்திருந்த சகோதரர்கள் திலோத்தமையைக் கண்டு, இருவரும் அவள் கையைப் பற்றித் தன் மனைவி என்கிறார்கள்; கதைகளால் போரிட்டு ஒருவரையொருவர் கொல்கிறார்கள். அத்தகைய கதியைத் தவிர்க்குமாறு நாரதர் சொல்ல, திரௌபதியுடன் தனித்திருக்கும் சகோதரனைக் குறுக்கிடுபவன் பன்னிரண்டு ஆண்டுகள் காட்டில் வாழ வேண்டும் என்று பாண்டவர்கள் நியமம் செய்துகொள்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: വിന്ധ്യപർവതത്തിൽ ആഘോഷിക്കുന്നതിനിടെ സഹോദരന്മാർ തിലോത്തമയെ കാണുന്നു; ഓരോരുത്തരും അവളുടെ കൈ പിടിച്ച് തന്റെ ഭാര്യയെന്ന് അവകാശപ്പെടുന്നു; ഗദകൊണ്ട് പോരാടി അവർ പരസ്പരം കൊല്ലുന്നു. ഇത്തരം വിധിയിൽ നിന്ന് വിട്ടുനിൽക്കാൻ നാരദൻ പാണ്ഡവരെ ഉപദേശിക്കുന്നു; ദ്രൗപദിയോടൊപ്പം ഒരു സഹോദരൻ ഏകാന്തതയിലാകുന്നതിൽ ഇടപെടുന്നവൻ പന്ത്രണ്ടു വർഷം വനത്തിൽ പോകണമെന്ന് അവർ ഉടമ്പടി ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.204; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
जित्वा तु पृथिवीं दैत्यौ निःसपत्नौ गतव्यथौ ।
कृत्वा त्रैलोक्यमव्यग्रं कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: Having conquered the earth, the two Daityas, rivalless and free of worry, made the three worlds quiet and considered their task done.

verses.text:
देवगन्धर्वयक्षाणां नागपार्थिवरक्षसाम् ।
आदाय सर्वरत्नानि परां तुष्टिमुपागतौ ॥

meaning.en: Taking all the jewels of gods, gandharvas, yakshas, nagas, kings and rakshasas, they reached the highest contentment.

verses.text:
यदा न प्रतिषेद्धारस्तयोः सन्तीह केचन ।
निरुद्योगौ तदा भूत्वा विजह्रातेऽमराविव ॥

meaning.en: When no one anywhere could oppose them, they gave up all exertion and sported like immortals.

verses.text:
स्त्रीभिर्माल्यैश्च गन्धैश्च भक्षैर्भोज्यैश्च पुष्कलैः ।
पानैश्च विविधैर्हृद्यैः परां प्रीतिमवापतुः ॥

meaning.en: With women, garlands, perfumes, abundant food and drink and many pleasing beverages, they found supreme delight.

verses.text:
अन्तःपुरे वनोद्याने पर्वतोपवनेषु च ।
यथेप्सितेषु देशेषु विजह्रातेऽमराविव ॥

meaning.en: In the women's quarters, forest gardens and mountain groves, in any place they pleased, they played like immortals.

verses.text:
ततः कदाचिद्विन्ध्यस्य पृष्ठे समशिलातले ।
पुष्पिताग्रेषु शालेषु विहारमभिजग्मतुः ॥

meaning.en: Then once, on the back of the Vindhya mountain, on a level rock, they went to amuse themselves among sala trees in flower at their tips.

verses.text:
दिव्येषु सर्वकामेषु समानीतेषु तत्र तौ ।
वरासनेषु संहृष्टौ सह स्त्रीभिर्निषेदतुः ॥

meaning.en: There, with every divine pleasure brought to them, the two sat delighted on fine seats with their women.

verses.text:
ततो वादित्रनृत्ताभ्यामुपातिष्ठन्त तौ स्त्रियः ।
गीतैश्च स्तुतिसंयुक्तैः प्रीत्यर्थमुपजग्मिरे ॥

meaning.en: Then the women attended them with music and dance, and came to please them with songs mingled with praise.

verses.text:
ततस्तिलोत्तमा तत्र वने पुष्पाणि चिन्वती ।
वेषमाक्षिप्तमाधाय रक्तेनैकेन वाससा ॥

meaning.en: Just then Tilottama, gathering flowers in that forest, wearing a single red cloth that left her enticingly disordered,

verses.text:
नदीतीरेषु जातान्सा कर्णिकारान्विचिन्वती ।
शनैर्जगाम तं देशं यत्रास्तां तौ महासुरौ ॥

meaning.en: slowly came, picking karnikara blossoms growing on the riverbanks, to the place where the two great asuras sat.

verses.text:
तौ तु पीत्वा वरं पानं मदरक्तान्तलोचनौ ।
दृष्ट्वैव तां वरारोहां व्यथितौ संबभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: The two, who had drunk the choice wine and whose eyes were red-cornered with drunkenness, were shaken at the very sight of that lovely-limbed woman.

verses.text:
तावुत्पत्यासनं हित्वा जग्मतुर्यत्र सा स्थिता ।
उभौ च कामसंमत्तावुभौ प्रार्थयतश्च ताम् ॥

meaning.en: Springing up from their seats, they went to where she stood, and both, mad with desire, begged her.

verses.text:
दक्षिणे तां करे सुभ्रूं सुन्दो जग्राह पाणिना ।
उपसुन्दोऽपि जग्राह वामे पाणौ तिलोत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: Sunda took the fair-browed woman by the right hand, and Upasunda took Tilottama by the left.

verses.text:
वरप्रदानमत्तौ तावौरसेन बलेन च ।
धनरत्नमदाभ्यां च सुरापानमदेन च ॥

meaning.en: They were intoxicated by their boon, by their own strength and power, by wealth and jewels, and by the drinking of wine.

verses.text:
सर्वैरेतैर्मदैर्मत्तावन्योन्यं भ्रुकुटीकृतौ ।
मदकामसमाविष्टौ परस्परमथोचतुः ॥

meaning.en: Drunk with all these intoxications, frowning at each other and possessed by drunkenness and desire, they spoke to one another.

verses.text:
मम भार्या तव गुरुरिति सुन्दोऽभ्यभाषत ।
मम भार्या तव वधूरुपसुन्दोऽभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: She is my wife, your elder, Sunda said; She is my wife, your daughter-in-law, said Upasunda.

verses.text:
नैषा तव ममैषेति तत्र तौ मन्युराविशत् ।
तस्या हेतोर्गदे भीमे तावुभावप्यगृह्णताम् ॥

meaning.en: She is not yours, she is mine! Rage entered them there, and for her sake both seized their terrible maces.

verses.text:
तौ प्रगृह्य गदे भीमे तस्याः कामेन मोहितौ ।
अहं पूर्वमहं पूर्वमित्यन्योन्यं निजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Taking up their fearful maces, deluded by desire for her, they struck each other, each crying, Me first, me first!

verses.text:
तौ गदाभिहतौ भीमौ पेततुर्धरणीतले ।
रुधिरेणावलिप्ताङ्गौ द्वाविवार्कौ नभश्च्युतौ ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the maces, the two fearsome ones fell to the ground, their bodies smeared with blood, like two suns fallen from the sky.

verses.text:
ततस्ता विद्रुता नार्यः स च दैत्यगणस्तदा ।
पातालमगमत्सर्वो विषादभयकम्पितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the women fled, and the whole host of Daityas went down to Patala, shaking with grief and fear.

verses.text:
ततः पितामहस्तत्र सह देवैर्महर्षिभिः ।
आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा पूजयिष्यंस्तिलोत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Grandfather came there with the gods and great sages, pure in spirit, to honor Tilottama.

verses.text:
वरेण छन्दिता सा तु ब्रह्मणा प्रीतिमेव ह ।
वरयामास तत्रैनां प्रीतः प्राह पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Offered a boon by Brahma, she chose only his pleasure, and the pleased Grandfather spoke to her.

verses.text:
आदित्यचरिताँल्लोकान्विचरिष्यसि भामिनि ।
तेजसा च सुदृष्टां त्वां न करिष्यति कश्चन ॥

meaning.en: You will roam the worlds where the sun travels, radiant lady, and because of your brilliance no one will be able to gaze on you fully.

verses.text:
एवं तस्यै वरं दत्त्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
इन्द्रे त्रैलोक्यमाधाय ब्रह्मलोकं गतः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Having given her this boon, the Grandfather of all worlds placed the three worlds in Indra's hands and went to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
एवं तौ सहितौ भूत्वा सर्वार्थेष्वेकनिश्चयौ ।
तिलोत्तमार्थे संक्रुद्धावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Thus those two, who were united and of one mind in everything, became enraged over Tilottama and killed each other.

verses.text:
तस्माद्ब्रवीमि वः स्नेहात्सर्वान्भरतसत्तमान् ।
यथा वो नात्र भेदः स्यात्सर्वेषां द्रौपदीकृते ।
तथा कुरुत भद्रं वो मम चेत्प्रियमिच्छथ ॥

meaning.en: Therefore, out of affection I tell you, best of the Bharatas, all of you: do what ensures no division among you over Draupadi, if you wish to please me. May you prosper.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता महात्मानो नारदेन महर्षिणा ।
समयं चक्रिरे राजंस्तेऽन्योन्येन समागताः ।
समक्षं तस्य देवर्षेर्नारदस्यामितौजसः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by the great sage Narada, those great-souled men met together, O king, and made an agreement in the presence of the divine sage Narada of boundless energy.

verses.text:
द्रौपद्या नः सहासीनमन्योऽन्यं योऽभिदर्शयेत् ।
स नो द्वादश वर्षाणि ब्रह्मचारी वने वसेत् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever of us is seen by another sitting with Draupadi shall live in the forest for twelve years as a celibate student.

verses.text:
कृते तु समये तस्मिन्पाण्डवैर्धर्मचारिभिः ।
नारदोऽप्यगमत्प्रीत इष्टं देशं महामुनिः ॥

meaning.en: When this agreement was made by the Pandavas, devoted to dharma, the great sage Narada, pleased, went to the place he desired.

verses.text:
एवं तैः समयः पूर्वं कृतो नारदचोदितैः ।
न चाभिद्यन्त ते सार्वे तदान्योन्येन भारत ॥

meaning.en: Thus the agreement was made by them at Narada's urging, and then none of them fell out with one another, O Bharata.
